topic: How Multilayer Perceptrons (MLP) Store Facts in Transformers

sections.title: The Analogy: The 'Library' inside the Transformer
lecture_lines: Attention layers act as dynamic readers.
MLPs function as static, long-term memory.
Think of MLPs as a giant database.
They store facts like 'Paris is France's capital'.
animations: FadeIn Attention [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/library.svg] and MLP blocks, colored #3498DB and #E74C3C respectively.
Highlight Attention block #3498DB with a pulsing glow effect.
Highlight MLP block #E74C3C with a static, dense glow effect.
Animate MLP block expanding into a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/shelf.svg] of small storage cells.
Display text 'Paris -> France' inside a specific MLP storage cell.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of Weight Vectors as Keys
lecture_lines: Facts are stored as weight vectors.
Weights act like keys in memory.
Neurons behave as addressable storage locations.
animations: Transform the vector into a key shape icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/key.svg] colored #F1C40F.
Populate the screen with a grid of addressable key slots.

sections.title: Mechanism: The Key-Value Memory Model
animations: Slide an input [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/switch.svg] into a specific memory slot.
Change the slot's border color to #2ECC71 to indicate activation.
Fade out input and display a retrieved 'Value' vector icon #9B59B6.

sections.title: Visualizing Fact Storage: The Embedding Space
lecture_lines: Learning shifts weights via gradient descent.
Facts are etched into the network.
Weights align to map input to output.
animations: Show a vector arrow rotating towards a target orientation using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hammer.svg] to strike and guide the alignment.
Show particles carving/etching a path into the weight landscape using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/chisel.svg] to refine the geometry.
Display finalized alignment between two vectors with a connecting arc, reinforced by the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/chisel.svg] carving the final path.

lecture_lines: This is neural memory in action.
